newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends off, mkt awaits mini-band drop.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends off, mkt awaits mini-band drop.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.04 percent to close at 1.0711 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market on expectations for a decline of 0.1 percent in the reais-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The current mini-band was set by the Central Bank Friday at between 1.0700 and 1.0750 reais.
Dealers also cited dollar outflows, even though preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $10 million surplus on Tuesday.
Preliminary figures for dollar flows, however, are not always accurate.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0755, up 0.01 percent.
In the parallel market, the real ended steady at 1.130, according to traders.
